meta.title: AI Usage Monitor
meta.description: Adds an AI usage monitor to the left sidebar: click its icon in the sidebar's panel list to open it. The panel shows the provider and model of the latest call, input, output, cache and reasoning tokens per task, session and all listed sessions, the estimated USD cost from published per-million-token rates, a bar for the context window and the approximate headroom of the next request, optional generation-speed and cache-hit indicators, history by model, editable rates with a verification date, and an optional DeepSeek account balance. An EN/ES toggle at the top switches the whole interface between English and Spanish. It reads the Harness tokenUsage, contextPressure and sessionStats projections plus two projections this plugin contributes, so it makes no model request; the only extra request is the account balance, and only after you enable it. Rates default to DeepSeek's published list, the peak/off-peak split follows the UTC windows, and Chinese public holidays are not modelled, so costs are estimates; a model without a verified rate is shown as unavailable or as an incomplete estimate rather than guessed. Session history by model only covers sessions logged after this plugin was first enabled. Disabling the plugin removes the panel, the floating card and its sidebar entry. Author: Alejavi Rivera (YouTube @alejavirivera).
